capabilities: switch to previous or next tab with hotkeys
pick a tab from a modal using one-letter keys
assign one-letter shortcuts shown over tabs
find and open tabs by keyword search
close tabs from the browse modal
disambiguation: It switches between open tabs, not files in the vault; it does not search note content.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in keyboard-friendly way to jump between open tabs the way browsers or editors do.
summary: Tab switcher that lets you move between open tabs via previous/next hotkeys, a letter-key modal, one-key shortcuts, or name search.
